title: A Trip to Mexico
text:
Last summer, Sara visited Mexico with her friend Lucia. They took a plane to Mexico City and stayed in a small hotel near the center. Every morning, they ate fresh fruit and walked through the markets. The city was big, but the people were very friendly.

On the last day, they took a bus to a beach near the city. The water was warm and blue, and they swam for hours. Sara took many photos of the sunset. She says it was the best trip of her life.

paragraph_translations: El verano pasado, Sara visitó México con su amiga Lucia. Tomaron un avión a la Ciudad de México y se quedaron en un hotel pequeño cerca del centro. Cada mañana comían fruta fresca y caminaban por los mercados. La ciudad era grande, pero la gente era muy amable.

El último día, tomaron un autobús a una playa cerca de la ciudad. El agua estaba tibia y azul, y nadaron durante horas. Sara tomó muchas fotos de la puesta del sol. Ella dice que fue el mejor viaje de su vida.
